cases.rationale: The addition chain is inside an always_comb procedural region. RTL Advisor classified that region outside the released rewrite scope and did not authorize candidate generation; no independently proved and identically measured broader candidate was established.

The ternary expression combines selection with separate two-operand additions and is not a pure supported three-or-more-addend expression. RTL Advisor excluded it and did not authorize a candidate; no broader candidate reached the required proof and identical two-recipe measurement bar.

This priority decoder is procedural selection logic, not an unsigned fixed-width combinational addition chain. RTL Advisor excluded the procedural region, and no independently proved and identically measured decode rewrite was established.

The first addition is explicitly truncated to eight bits before the later nine-bit result, so reassociation across that boundary can change behavior. RTL Advisor excluded the sites for too few addends and width/truncation risk and did not authorize a candidate.

The released transform requires an unsigned output with explicit fixed width; this chain and target are signed. RTL Advisor excluded the target type and did not authorize candidate generation, and no independent signed-semantics proof and measurement chain was established.
The only addition expression already has RTL Advisor's deterministic balanced shape, so no candidate is needed or supported.

The nested operations cross an automatic saturating-add function boundary rather than forming a direct pure addition chain. RTL Advisor excluded the function region and did not authorize a released-family candidate; no independently proved and measured broader rewrite was established.
